 How Faster Truth Social Access Will Impact Trump Media Stock
 October 29, 2026 SI Simply Wall St Reviewed by Sasha Jovanovic Trump Media & Technology Group, through Truth Social, has previously agreed to let Bloomberg and two Wall Street trading firms pay up to US$100,000 a month for faster access to Donald Trump’s posts via a paid Truth API feed, a service now drawing legal and political scrutiny.
 The arrangement highlights how Trump Media is testing a high-priced data product built around presidential communications. It raises questions over regulatory risk, revenue quality, and how dependent its business model may be on time-sensitive access to Trump’s posts.
 We will look at how Trump Media’s investment narrative is affected by monetising faster Truth Social access for Wall Street trading clients.
 Compare how Trump Media & Technology Group’s data driven story stacks up against other high-momentum plays by scanning our hand picked 19 high quality undiscovered gems with strong fundamentals.
 Advertisement What Is Trump Media & Technology Group's Investment Narrative?
 For Trump Media & Technology Group, the core belief you need is that a relatively small US$4.5m revenue base can eventually support a full social and media ecosystem built around Truth Social, Truth+ and related data products. That is a high bar when the group is currently loss making, with net income of roughly US$1.3b in the red and a Return on Equity that sits deep in negative territory. The share price has fallen sharply over the past year, which indicates that sentiment is already fragile.
 The Truth API controversy fits straight into that operational reality. Management is experimenting with premium data access and aggressive pricing. Yet the absolute dollars involved from a few US$100,000 per month clients look small next to the scale of reported losses. The bigger swing factor in the near term is whether regulatory or legal pushback adds compliance cost, restricts how Truth Social can monetise presidential communications, or distracts a relatively new board and leadership team that is still bedding in.
 Even so, before treating the data monetisation story as a simple upside case, there is a structural weak point in Trump Media’s setup that ...
